data.name: Gloss_PassedOn
data.value: Money handed from one module to the next. The thicker the line, the more money.

data.name: Gloss_IntoBucket
data.value: Money that ends in one of the bar's buckets, its line running into it, or that comes back out of a bucket, its line then ending in an arrowhead. The thicker the line, the more money.

data.name: Gloss_TaxBase
data.value: What changes the amount a tax is worked out on without moving money: a benefit taxed with the pay, what Corporate tax adds back.

data.name: Gloss_Condition
data.value: A condition one module sets on another.

data.name: AllHidden
data.value: Every kind of link is hidden: tick one to see its links.
